roles.sourceCustodian: Freezes English keys/comments, concept IDs, synthetic content and provenance; authorizes minimum export scope.
roles.translator: Qualified professional familiar with sign inspection and construction/field vocabulary; locale-specific attribution.
roles.independentReviewer: Native/professional reviewer distinct from translator; in-context critical workflows and reports.
roles.bilingualPractitioner: Walks realistic synthetic sign workflows; recommended at least two participants per non-English locale.
roles.reportRecipient: Supervisor/recipient review of generated report is recommended.
roles.importCustodian: Verifies deliverable hashes, exact frozen source, terms, license and receipt; imports only within selected locale fence.
roles.acceptanceOwner: Supplies or authorizes real participants/evidence; approves the applicable later same-candidate acceptance gate.

export.format: Apple-supported localization export with source strings, semantic comments, declared placeholders/variants and synthetic context screenshots.
export.manualAuthorizedRoute: Use the task-pinned macOS/Xcode localization workflow only when that route and locale fence are authorized; no export executed by this card.
export.requiredAttestation: Source custodian inspects every exported text and image for synthetic-only content before external sharing. Validator cannot prove privacy or review identity.
export.retention: Record authorized purpose, minimum recipient access, return deadline and deletion/return obligation in the license terms; no vendor account or transfer created here.

required: exact required keys and variant families match
placeholder types/counts and do-not-translate tokens match
explicit locale, translator, reviewer, license/usage terms and receipt
selected locale path fence; shared integration reserved to P04-C07
import.transaction: Validate in an isolated review packet first. Reject unknown or missing fields, duplicate keys, escaped paths, unmatched source keys and changed machine values before any import.
import.sourceControl: No automatic import, commit, push or acceptance by the validator.

stages: Freeze source/key set and termbase revision.
Prepare minimum synthetic packet and privacy attestation.
Export through supported Apple workflow in an authorized native lane.
Professional translation; machine assistance remains a nonshipping draft.
Mechanically validate packet, placeholders, plural/variation families, integrity and complete keys.
Import only into active locale fence; preserve English and unrelated locales.
Run authorized pseudolanguage/locale checks and capture exact-candidate screenshots.
Independent native/professional and bilingual workflow review of critical paths, reports, errors, destructive actions, accessibility and metadata.
Produce ACCEPTED_NO_CORRECTION or CORRECTION_REQUIRED only at the authorized later review gate.

requirements: actual observed language, device, OS, Dynamic Type, appearance, contrast and keyboard state
same artifacts bound by every review receipt

correction.causalOwner: Same logical card ID; direct-child correction candidate records correctionOf rejected tuple/receipt.
correction.sharedCorrection: Return to shared source/termbase owner, repeat every affected locale before P04-C07.

conditionalRepeats.V30-P05-C02: Only when B/P/S replay map changes.

correction.history: Preserve superseded packets, releases and receipts append-only. Downstream P06 evidence loses acceptance on any tuple mismatch; no graph changes.
correction.downstreamGate: P06-C03 through P06-C07 consume only the same ACCEPTED_NO_CORRECTION tuple.

offlineAndFallback.requiredCatalogs: Bundled for startup and offline field use; no network translation dependency.
offlineAndFallback.fallback: No unresolved keys or unexpected English in a declared-complete locale. Explicit do-not-translate/fallback dispositions require owner and context; a missing translation is not automatically approved.
offlineAndFallback.machineDraft: Machine assistance is DRAFT_NONSHIPPING only and cannot create reviewer identities, receipts or acceptance.

validatorContract.default: Validate the three foundation artifacts and their frozen source bindings.
validatorContract.selfTest: --self-test runs temporary synthetic structural tests only.
validatorContract.credit: PASS means structural/integrity checks only; never linguistic, native, release, main or final acceptance.
validatorContract.packetTransfer: No network, import, upload or message action.
validatorContract.correctionInput: For revision > 1, supply --predecessor PREVIOUS_PACKET.json. Digest, stream/revision, rejected receipt ID and tuple must match supersedes/correctionOf. This checks evidence binding, not Git ancestry or reviewer authenticity.
validatorContract.pluralPolicy: Require one/other for en and es (es may include many); require other for zh-Hans, zh-Hant, vi and ko. Every device variant family is preserved. This mechanical category check does not qualify runtime plural selection or language quality.
